shared_prefix: visit every declared front inspection pose in geometric order, end at the corridor midpoint anchor, then execute one paid 360-degree in-place camera sweep
candidate_cap_basis: four coverage slots + one rotation + entry/deep for the declared maximum of 24 measured components
branch_execution: execute the sealed round trip while each successor retains a latest-map return; switch to the current shortest safe return if the original route is denied
training_target: (terminal covered_2d_area_m2 * terminal global_3d_f1_at_5cm - shared-prefix value) / actual paid branch actions
failure_policy: retain all denied routes, fallback returns, collisions and metric results; a safe fallback return is valid executed-option evidence but must be flagged as not completing the original route
pilot_exclusion_reason: created before the shared anchor sweep; retain for diagnosis but do not mix with the revised training histories
claim_boundary: development branch collection only; no closed-loop or confirmation claim
